newsitem.title: UK: Molins shares slide on accounting error.
newsitem.headline: Molins shares slide on accounting error.

text.p: Shares in UK engineering group Molins Plc fell twenty percent on Wednesday after the company revealed accounting irregularities which had overstated the group's 1996 profits.
The shares were down 147-1/2p to 595p by 0744 GMT after initially falling to a two year low of 565p.

Molins said earlier that accounting errors at its U.S. subsidiary Langston Corp, could impact on pre-tax profits to the tune of around $12 million. Adjustments will probably be treated as exceptional items in the group's 1997 accounts.
The president and chief financial officer of Langston have been dismissed.
